scope: Independent material design review of the N06/22 proposal only; no source, per-item, identity-map, migration, consumer, admission, native/Premium or full BIZQ-01 acceptance.

rationale.fit: One existing ten-unit node and its 180-object review scope advance the open BIZQ-01 objective while preserving the distinction between source-package acceptance and full-area completion.
rationale.simplicity: A single coordinated proposal/review package uses the existing producer and admission path; exact proof design is intentionally reviewed later against the frozen identity map.
rationale.risk: The plan binds current source before authoring, classifies 21 contract gaps as ambiguity rather than wrong answers, and makes identity item-specific after semantic review.
rationale.maintainability: It preserves IDs when meaning remains, separates option identity, retains historical guards, and avoids a generic override or alternate runtime path.

requiredPreAuthoringDependency.condition: Before authoring, freeze and verify the exact ten current source arrays and 180 whole objects against current source version and question-set hash, and confirm the 159 confirmed / 21 contract-gap dispositions against those exact bytes. This is the briefing's own prerequisite; this design verdict does not assert the future bindings.

notApproved: N06 item semantics or answer identity actions
Producer proof shape or historical reconstruction implementation
Source activation, app consumer synchronization, candidate admission or runtime readiness
Native/Premium, full-bank, full BIZQ-01, deployment or publication
